faqs.a: We're located at 123 Health St., Wellness City. Parking available behind the building.
We accept Blue Cross Blue Shield, Aetna, Cigna, UnitedHealthcare and Medicare.
Mon-Fri 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM; Sat 9:00 AM - 12:00 PM; Sun closed.

faqs.q: What should I bring to my first visit?
faqs.a: A photo ID, insurance card, current medications list, and completed intake form if you have one.
Cancel at least 24 hours in advance to avoid a cancellation fee.
